title.zh: Solflare：质押服务商发生安全事件，相关验证节点奖励暂停
title.en: Solflare：质押服务商发生安全事件，相关验证节点奖励暂停

current_state.zh: Solflare reported a security breach at its staking provider that compromised its validator keys, suspending staking rewards while it migrates delegators to a new validator, with user SOL confirmed safe and a compensation plan planned.
current_state.en: Solflare reported a security breach at its staking provider that compromised its validator keys, suspending staking rewards while it migrates delegators to a new validator, with user SOL confirmed safe and a compensation plan planned.
